title: Realms of Old
description: This modpack adds a whole new level of immersion into the minecraft world. Explore new dimensions, mobs, and items
body:
Step beyond the familiar… and rediscover Minecraft as a world of myth, danger, and forgotten power.

Realms of Old is a deeply immersive modpack that transforms your survival experience into an epic journey across ancient dimensions, reimagined worlds, and richly layered gameplay systems. Every step forward feels earned, every discovery meaningful.
